Name: Lake Formation
Description: Group containing parameters for generating lakes on the terrain, including formation, placement, and water body characteristics.

Name: Precipitation
Description: Controls the amount of water available for lake formation, influencing the size and number of lakes generated.

Name: Small Lakes
Description: Enables or adjusts the creation of smaller lakes, increasing the frequency of minor water bodies across the terrain.

Name: Flood Control
Description: Limits excessive flooding by managing water distribution, preventing lakes from overflowing or merging unnaturally.

Name: Water Floor
Description: Sets the elevation of the lake bed, determining the minimum depth and base level of the water body.

Name: Shore Formation
Description: Group containing parameters for shaping and detailing the lake shorelines, including width and transition effects.

Name: Shore Size
Description: Controls the width and extent of the shoreline around lakes, affecting how far the shore transitions into the surrounding terrain.

Name: Altitude Bias
Description: Biases lake placement towards certain altitudes, favoring higher or lower terrain for lake formation.

Name: Size Bias
Description: Adjusts the likelihood of generating larger or smaller lakes, influencing the overall distribution of lake sizes.
